terminals.name: temporal-server
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.temporalio/bin:$PATH"; mkdir -p .demo; temporal server start-dev --db-filename .demo/temporal.db --ui-port 8233 --log-level warn

terminals.name: worker
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.temporalio/bin:$PATH"; until curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8233; do sleep 1; done; go run ./worker
